messages:
harper: quick heads-up, PR 533 landed as WIP for console/observability docs. found a few small but blocking issues in review: inconsistent metric keys across examples, missing Go and Rust snippets for tracehook parity, and a dead anchor to the legacy-cost section. can we coordinate fixes?
aj: on it. prefer canonical keys `token_cost_usd` and `latency_ms`. i'll grep & replace in docs and add a docs-lint rule to catch old variants like `per_token_cost` and `cost_tokens_usd`.
lia: i can add the Go snippet. want it super tiny (create hook, attach ctx, set two tags) so it doesn't bloat pages. also i'll add an inline note about units.
sam_r: i'll add the Rust snippet (minimal) and run a staging preview to check anchors/links. if there's a 404 for embeds we should add a static fallback image.
docs-bot: PR 533 opened by harper  reviewers: @aj @lia. CI: docs-link-check queued.
harper: anchor issue is `#legacy-costs` -> the header changed to "Legacy cost breakdown" earlier, so the markdown anchor moved. small fix to add an alias anchor or reinstate previous header is fine.
aj: plan: i'll push a tiny commit to normalize keys and add a migration note in docs/console/CHANGELOG.md. also will include an autofix suggestion in the PR description (jq one-liner).
lia: Go draft (keeps it <8 lines): ```go
import "github.com/redwood/trace"

hook := trace.NewHook("console-playback")
hook.AttachContext(map[string]string{"trace_id": traceID})
hook.SetTag("token_cost_usd", 0.0032)
hook.SetTag("latency_ms", 110)
```
sam_r: Rust draft: ```rust
use redwood::trace::TraceHook;
let mut hook = TraceHook::new("console-playback");
hook.attach_context(&[("trace_id", trace_id)]);
hook.set_tag("token_cost_usd", 0.0032);
hook.set_tag("latency_ms", 110);
```
aj: LGTM. i'll add the linter rule and a unit test. docs-lint will error on `per_token_cost`/`cost_tokens_usd`. i'll add a short migration snippet to the migration guide showing how to rename keys in saved dashboard JSONs.
docs-bot: docs-link-check result: found broken anchor for legacy cost section and a 404 on embed `/interactive/cost-demo` (expected 200). created infra ticket infra#421 for missing route.
harper: thanks. sam_r please add a fallback: if iframe returns 404 render `/assets/cost-demo-static.png` with caption "Interactive demo temporarily unavailable". small guard so docs aren't empty.
sam_r: adding fallback now. also will update staging preview after commits.
infra-bot: infra#421 created and assigned to @dave. note: router cleanup PR changed route names; likely regression.
aj: pushing WIP linter and migration note. will also add changelog entry to warn about key rename so integrators aren't surprised.
docs-bot: after fallback added, docs-link-check shows page 200, iframe still 404, static fallback present. PR marked blocked on infra#421 for full interactive experience.
harper: plan summary: lia adds Go snippet + unit note, sam_r adds Rust snippet + static fallback, aj normalizes keys + linter + migration note, infra investigates route alias. target merge once infra confirms route or we keep fallback. will mark PR as WIP/blocked and update reviewers. thanks all :tada: /end of thread
